inputs.text: Extreme close-up macro photograph of one single human eye, seen straight on from the front, filling the whole square frame from edge to edge. The round hazel-green iris with fine radial fibres and the black pupil sit exactly in the centre of the frame. Wide open eyelids with dark lashes along the top and bottom edges. Glossy wet white sclera with faint thin red veins. One small bright wet specular highlight on the cornea. Low-key lighting: only the eyeball is lit, the eyelids and corners fade into near-black shadow. Sharp focus, realistic
